newsitem.title: FRANCE: Oddo raises rating on Lafarge after sales.
newsitem.headline: Oddo raises rating on Lafarge after sales.

text.p: Brokerage Oddo said on Thursday it had raised its recommendation on the stock in building materials group Lafarge to '2', or overweight, from '3', or underweight, and increased its earnings estimates for the company.
Lafarge on Wednesday afternoon reported a 6.2 percent rise in 1996 sales to 35.26 billion francs, above Oddo's expectation of annual sales of 33.72 billion.
Oddo increased its 1996 earnings per share (EPS) estimate to 22.40 francs from 21.90, its 1997 EPS forecast to 25.60 francs from 25.30, and its 1998 forecast to 27.60 francs from 25.80.
Shares in Lafarge were up 0.32 percent at 347.40 francs at 1030 GMT.
